lines.en: And so begins another lonely day in the office.
Upon thinking more about it, this whole ‘guidance counselor’ thing doesn’t really make sense to me, to be honest.
Most days, I just find myself sitting here for an hour or two before calling it quits and going home.
Sure, there are rare occasions where someone will actually stop by...but I think only one of those occasions has actually involved counseling so far.
Two, maybe- if you count being blown off by Yumi as counseling. Which I do not.
Welp, it looks like someone else is here to take advantage of both my office hours and a position I am absolutely not qualified for.
: Come in.
And...it looks like it's someone entirely unexpected.
: Huh...
: What do you mean “Huh?” Am I not allowed to use this office for the same unintended purposes everyone else uses it for?
: That depends on whether or not you are here for a shoulder massage.
: What? Ew. No.
: Is that seriously what you've been using this place for?
: You're disgusting...
: So, what brings you here today, Maya?
: It’s not often you actually come to see me. In fact, I’m pretty sure that this is the first time this has ever happened.
: That is correct. And don't take my arrival here as some sort of omen for things to come. I would like to clarify first and foremost that I absolutely do not want to be here right now.
: Well, that's a good start to this conversation.
: The fact of the matter is, if I didn’t remind you of something soon, horrible things would likely follow.
: That’s...ominous.
: What is truly ominous is your existence and all of the horrible things that occur because of it.
: So, how is this new world treating you?
: You mean the world that I have been in forever?
: No. I mean the one that you continuously deny that you’ve been reborn into even though we both know that is not the case.
: I'm just going to assume you mean the world I've been in forever- which has been pretty good so far, I guess.
: Nothing strange has happened?
: Well...I wouldn’t say that.
: Please clarify.
: Well, I think I’ve been having some strange dreams lately.
: You think?
: Well...they feel like dreams, but I’m not really sure if that's what they are or not.
: Dreams of what, exactly?
: That...is kind of hard to explain.
: Can you try? I'm actually curious now.
: Well, I am completely aware of how insane this will make me sound...but do you know anything about a...sort of...
: Room with clocks?
: There are many rooms with clocks in them. I’m not sure which one you’re talking about.
: No, like...one room with way too many clocks.
: Were they like...different kinds of clocks or something?...
: Because I'm really confused about why something that unremarkable would be the first thing you go to in order to quantify how strange this world is.
: There was other stuff that happened in the dream. It's all...blurry for the most part. But I remember seeing someone who looked a lot like you there.
: Oh. Wonderful. So it was that type of dream.
: It really wasn't. In fact, I will confirm right now that I didn't even touch dream-Maya.
: Do you...want a medal for that or something?
: No. But some acknowledgement that I'm not as bad as you say I am would be nice.
: Are you forgetting the part roughly one minute ago where you admitted to molesting a girl in this very office?
: Massage. Not molest.
: Sorry, how old are you again?
: I honestly don't know.
: Then I will answer for you- old enough for there to be no difference between massage and molest. Now, can we please get back to the aspects of your dream that don't involve touching me?
There is no winning with this girl.
: Fine. What else do you want to know?
: To start, are there any other important details you remember about this dream? Or was it just...clocks and me?
: The thing is I don't even know if it was you. She was identical, but I...remember her acting very...different from how you typically act.
: How depressing that you must resort to dreams of me being nice to you since it will never happen in real life.
: Okay, you know what? I don't think I'm going to talk about that dream anymore since it was clearly just some...ridiculous and random REM-induced brain voyage.
: That's probably a good call. But that aside, has anything else strange happened?
: One more thing. But it's going to make me sound strange again.
: I can assure you I am quite used to that by now.
: Then...how do you feel about the letter T?
: What?
: Told you.
: What does the letter T have to do with anything? Is that...some sort of code?
: No. Well, at least I don’t think it is.
: I’m not really sure.
: I just vaguely remember something about that letter recently. But I feel like it's...a memory I'm not really supposed to have? Does that make any sense?
: Not really...
: Besides, what relevancy would that have to me? Asking me how I feel implies that I have something to do with this, doesn't it?
: Dream-Maya was there again.
: Is she just in all of your dreams now? Because that is quite sickening and does not make me feel very safe.
: I wouldn’t worry too much about it...It's probably just more meaningless brain vomit.
: I sincerely hope that is true for the sake of both of us.
: So, did anything else happen? Or is that it?
: Uhh...No? I don’t think so at least?
: What about with you? We’re in the counseling room. So if you have any issues, this is the best place to air them out.
: Yeah...I can promise you that if I did have any issues, you’d be one of the last people I'd go to for help.
: One of? So I’m not in last place?
: Second to last. I wouldn’t celebrate just yet.
: Well...who is last then?
: That would have to be God.
: Aren’t you a shrine maiden?
: Only because I have to be.
: You...have to be a shrine maiden?
: It's very complicated. You wouldn't understand.
: Then I think you’re going to have to tell me more about it.
: Please don’t tell me what I have to do. That sort of methodology might work on Ami and Ayane, but not me.
: I didn’t mean that you literally have to...I’m just curious.
: Well, I am very sorry, but this is one of many cases in life where you'll just have to remain curious.
: For now, though...let me get to the real reason I’m here.
: Oh, right. You said you wanted to remind me of something, correct?
: Correct, but before I remind you, there is something I would like to ask. And I’d appreciate it if you would answer as honestly as possible.
: Oh...uhh, sure. What’s up?
: Are you happy here?
: You mean...Kumon-mi?
: More or less.
Why exactly would Maya care about something as trivial as my happiness?
This isn't some sort of trick question, is it?
Regardless...she did ask me to answer as honestly as possible...
So...
I am happy here
: I guess so. Kumon-mi is pretty nice.
: Plus, this is probably the closest I’ll ever get to having a harem, so that's a plus.
: And there you go immediately ruining everything.
: Do you really think you’ll be able to romance everyone without some form of consequence?
: If I am very careful? Probably.
: Well...I have no intention of trying to stop you.
: Just know that I think you're absolutely disgusting and would be better off locked up in some room far, far away from teenage girls for the rest of your life.
: If that ever happens, will you at least come by to feed me every now and then?
: No. I will leave you there to starve.
: I'd say something like “Remind me to not get on your bad side,” but I'm pretty sure I've been there from the start, so...
I am miserable INCORRECT ANSWER. IGNORE ME.
: I feel great!
: YOU WOULD FEEL BETTER INSIDE OF ME.
: I see.
: Well that’s good at least.
: It sure is.
: Well, now that that’s out of the way, I guess I’ll cut to the chase.
: Something important is going to happen with Ami soon.
: Important? What do you mean?
: I mean that something she cares very much about is going to happen soon.
: And it’s something you care about too.
: Do you mean me? Or me?
: It doesn’t make a difference. I dislike both versions of you equally.
: That's unfortunate. I was just starting to think we were friends.
: Quit joking around for a moment...I’m serious.
: If you so much as even upset Ami, I swear on everything in this world that I will destroy you.
: That's fine. It's not like I'm actively trying to hurt her or anything. But...what’s this allegedly important thing that's going to happen?
: How can I be prepared for it if I don't know what it is?
: You’ll know when the time comes.
: How can you be so sure of that?
: I just am.
: Now, if you’ll excuse me...I would like to go eat pizza with my friends.
: Oh. Uhh...sure. You’re-
: Thank you and goodbye.
: Oh...and one more thing.
Maya calls out to me from the hall before closing the door.
: Not everything is always as it seems.
: I'd ask that you remember that.
Maya closes the door and I’m left confused and alone.
As such, I decide to pack up and leave the office a little early today.
